gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: In 2021, Syndicate 1084 reported a prior year reserve release of $105.2 million, representing 3.70% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This release was primarily driven by favourable claims development on prior year losses, predominantly affecting the Treaty, Marine, and Energy divisions. The syndicate also reported losses in 2021 from natural catastrophes such as Hurricane Ida, US Winter Storms (combined net loss $76.2m), and European Floods Bernd, as well as the man-made South Africa Riots (net loss $39.2m). Prior year (2020) events like the Covid-19 pandemic and Global Economic Crisis (net loss $132.0m), and Hurricanes Laura and Sally (net loss $33.3m) also contributed to the overall claims experience.
